title: Queen's Blade: Limit Break
html:
Queen's Blade: Limit Break
Developer G123
Publisher Hobby Japan
Composer
Platform HMTL5 (free to play)
Release Date 2022
Genre Idle RPG
Mode
Rating

Queen's Blade: Limit Break is a HTML5 based free to play idle RPG. It features characters from Queen's Blade Unlimited as well as new characters exclusive to the game in a turn-based auto battle setting.
